title: Knowing the Holy Spirit as Your Comforter and Guide
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he dives into the foundational truth of the Trinity and the crucial role of the Holy Spirit in our lives. In this first sermon of a new series, Pastor Chris explores Jesus' words in John 14, revealing the comfort, guidance, and presence of the Holy Spirit that we can experience today. Don't miss this powerful message as Pastor Chris lays the groundwork for a deeper understanding of the Holy Spirit and His life-changing influence in our lives.
